A_NO_PRODUCTION_CHANGE.requirement: the 90.11% is materially driven by identity/granularity variance AND semantic stability already satisfies >=95%
A_NO_PRODUCTION_CHANGE.evidence: First half holds: 348/372 (93.5%) of non-id-stable material items are identity-attributable (196 span-boundary, 108 split/merge, 44 role-label) and Pass B/C consumed them regardless (captured-status stability 98.98%). Second half FAILS: semantic inventory stability is 90.4% lenient / 88.4% adjudicated / 78.4% conservative / 86.7% coverage-weighted - none reaches 95%. The pre-registered gate is not met on the corrected metric either, so no-change is not available.

B_PASS_A_IDENTITY_NORMALIZATION_FIX.evidence: Deterministic boundary normalization (strip leading enumerators/conjunctions/punctuation, trailing punctuation) would collapse 90/196 (45.9%) of span-variance pairs to identical ids, but exact-id stability is not the gate and identity is not what is unstable in a way that matters: the residual failures are text the coarser run never touched. Changing the id derivation would also re-key every frozen inventory and lineage (RVD-1 canonicalization operates on these ids) for no accountability gain. Cross-run semantic equivalence is inherently pairwise and lives in the comparator (scripts), which is corrected in this mission instead.

C_PASS_A_PROMPT_SCHEMA_STABILITY_FIX.evidence: 04 establishes PASS_A_MODEL_OMISSION as the earliest failure layer with two measured signatures (region-tail omission, sub-clause omission). Production today cannot see either: Pass A accounts for every quantitative VALUE (uninventoriedValues) but not for operative TEXT. The bounded fix adds the missing deterministic accounting and one targeted completion step, entirely inside Pass A.

D_SOURCE_CONTEXT_FIX.evidence: Ruled out in 04: byte-identical source context across runs, 0/22 omissions in truncated regions.

E_MULTI_FACTOR_FIX.evidence: Not independently demonstrated: the comparator correction is not a production change, and every production-relevant omission traces to one mechanism.

boundedChange.scope: Pass A only: lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic-accountability/{inventory.ts, prompt.ts, types.ts} (wire-schema.ts unchanged - corrected after audit 22 item 10). Disclosure-only touches to reconciliation.ts (counts/reasons + a defense-in-depth refusal of completeness on residual segments), semantic/types.ts and semantic/compile.ts (failure-reason mapping). No change to Pass B composition, Pass C disposition semantics, IR, Phase 3C verifier, operative state, package graph, source-context.ts or reference-resolver.ts.
boundedChange.auditRemediation: After the fresh independent audit (22) three defects in the first v2 cut were fixed in the same bounded scope: (B1) the coverage-gap decision now precedes the empty-inventory branch, so an empty inventory over text carrying only the generic vocabulary is INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP; (B2'') only CRITICAL/MATERIAL item spans count as coverage, so REVIEW_UNCERTAIN/INFORMATIONAL echo items can never close a gap; (defense in depth) reconciliation.ts refuses semanticallyComplete and compile.ts raises SEMANTIC_INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP whenever uninventoriedSegments is non-empty, independent of the status string. Tests: pass-a-stability.test.ts 'audit B1', 'audit B2''', 'audit defense in depth'.
knownLimitations: Coverage accounting runs over the OPERATIVE region only; CROSS_REFERENCE_EXPANSION regions are context by contract (their own units account for them), so an expansion-region item present in one run and not the other is not surfaced (the 4-CRITICAL xref-1 cluster in 04 is exactly this case).

The 40-non-whitespace-character floor excludes the two shortest observed material omissions (21 and 36 chars); lowering it would surface connective noise - a deliberate, disclosed trade-off, not a measured optimum.
A condition FOLDED into a broader material span is covered by span arithmetic and cannot be detected by coverage accounting; only the offline matcher's conservative metric protects it.
mechanism: 1. DETERMINISTIC OPERATIVE-TEXT COVERAGE ACCOUNTING (zero cost): after normalization, the OPERATIVE region is segmented at generic clause boundaries (sentence ends, semicolons, enumerators such as (a)/(i)/(1)); a segment whose non-whitespace characters are <50% covered by accepted item spans, that is at least 40 non-whitespace characters long and that carries generic operative/conditional drafting language (shall/may/must/means/provided/except/other than/excluding/including/to the extent/unless/subject to/so long as/not to exceed/without duplication/in each case/less/plus/net of) is an UNCOVERED OPERATIVE SEGMENT.

2. ONE BOUNDED TARGETED GAP RE-INVENTORY CALL (only when uncovered segments exist): the model receives ONLY the uncovered segments (verbatim, with their region offsets) and the same obligations, and returns additional items that go through the identical anti-hallucination gate, value completion, id derivation and duplicate rejection. It never sees or edits the first pass's items (no LLM normalizes another LLM's output), so it can only ADD verified, source-anchored items.

3. SURFACED, NEVER DROPPED: segments still uncovered after the gap call are recorded as uninventoriedSegments (exact spans + excerpt) and the inventory status becomes INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP, which the existing semanticallyComplete rule (inventoryStatus must be INVENTORY_OK) turns into a non-complete unit - the system now truthfully knows what it did not inventory. The status is disclosed with the exact residual segments, never guessed material or immaterial.
boundedChange.whyThisIsNotOverNormalization: Nothing is merged, deduplicated across runs, or rewritten. Conditions and exceptions are never normalized away: the change only ever ADDS items or SURFACES gaps. Materiality of a surfaced gap is never decided deterministically (mission: the scanner never decides materiality) - the gap call or a reviewer does.
boundedChange.determinism: Segmentation, coverage arithmetic, the trigger, the status and the residual list are pure functions of (region text, accepted item spans). The only model-dependent step is the bounded gap call, which is subject to the same deterministic gate as the first pass.
boundedChange.antiEnumeration: The operative-language vocabulary is generic English drafting connectives; no issuer, section number, defined term, amount or benchmark appears. Tested with invented names/numbers/section styles (06-stability-tests.json).
boundedChange.expectedEffect: Region-tail omissions (a whole trailing definition left uncovered) and sub-clause omissions (>=40 chars of uncovered conditional text) become either inventoried by the gap call or visibly surfaced. Sub-40-char fragments ('and any other ...') remain below the surfacing floor by design to avoid flagging connective noise; they are also the least likely to change a compliance conclusion on their own.
boundedChange.costImpact: At most one extra small call per unit, only when gaps exist; input = uncovered segments only. Estimated +5-15% of Pass A cost on regions with gaps, zero on regions without.

comparatorCorrection.what: scripts/phase3-final-closure-forensics.ts and its matcher (scripts/lib/pass-a-semantic-matcher.ts) replace exact-id keying with source-first semantic clustering for stability measurement, reporting strict-id, lenient, conservative (folded conditional roles never normalized away; a differing value set never stable), strict-fold (every material fragment unstable - lower bound), adjudicated (uses model proposition prose - informational only) and coverage-weighted numbers side by side. The pre-registered 95% gate stays authoritative and is applied to the CONSERVATIVE figure only (corrected after audit 22 item 1a).

postAuditCorrection.correctedAfter: the third independent audit against the final freeze (22.reAudit.reAudit3), which returned BLOCKER
claimsWithdrawn: expectedEffect: 'region-tail omissions ... become either inventoried by the gap call or visibly surfaced' - FALSIFIED. The audit demonstrated a whole trailing covenant (a springing guarantee plus an all-assets first-lien grant, 148 non-whitespace chars, 0% covered) that was neither inventoried nor surfaced, because it matched none of the segment vocabulary. INVENTORY_OK, semanticallyComplete true, no failure reason, agreement rollup SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE.

knownLimitations: the 40-character floor justified as excluding fragments 'least likely to change a compliance conclusion on their own' - JUSTIFICATION WITHDRAWN. The audit showed an absolute debt prohibition (29 chars) and four enumerated Lien carve-outs (26-35 chars) falling below it.
postAuditCorrection.accurateDescriptionOfTheMechanism: Text is eligible to be reported as a gap only if it clears FIVE conjunctive filters: it matches a fixed connective vocabulary, AND is at least 40 non-whitespace characters (or opens with a bare conditional connective, at 16), AND is at most 50% covered by CRITICAL/MATERIAL model-declared spans, AND falls on a sentence/semicolon/colon/enumerator boundary, AND sits in an OPERATIVE region. Each filter alone is sufficient to silence a material omission. Coverage itself is arithmetic over model-declared spans with model-declared materiality, with no span-size or item-density check.
postAuditCorrection.whatRemainsTrue: Once a gap IS detected, it cannot be talked away: a non-covering gap item, a throwing gap call, and non-material gap items all leave the gap open, and both reconciliation and compile key on uninventoriedSegments.length independently of the status string. The audit verified all of these and could not break them.
postAuditCorrection.correctReconciliationRule: semanticallyComplete requires zero MONEY/PERCENT/RATIO uninventoried values IN THE REGION LITERALLY NAMED 'operative' - not zero uninventoried values. DAYS, PERIOD, DATE, MULTIPLIER and every value in an expansion region are outside the rule. This narrowing was in a code comment only and is now stated here.
